description: Global demand for spices marketed for medicinal/immunity-boosting properties surged during COVID-19; India's chilli export volume rose ~34.26% year-on-year in FY2020-21.

Guntur mandi bulletin recorded ~6 weeks of non-functional trading (Rs 0 quotes) during the national COVID-19 lockdown -- a local supply-chain disruption distinct from the export-demand surge happening at the same time.
source: This project's own data (see reports/ANALYSIS_REPORT.md Sec. 2)

description: Record export value years (Rs 10,444 Cr in FY2022-23, Rs 12,492 Cr in FY2023-24) coincide with the domestic price spike to an all-time high (~Rs 282/quintal-equiv, late 2022). China remained the top single buyer (~179,000 tonnes in 2023-24).
El Nino-linked weather was cited as damaging chilli crop quality/quantity in parts of India during 2023, alongside heavy monsoon rain in Madhya Pradesh.
source: commodity-board.com 'Indian Red Chilli Market Report for Year 2023'

description: FY2024-25 export volume rose ~19% but export value fell -- average realised export price per tonne declined, consistent with the domestic price series' retreat from its 2022-23 peak.
